svg.title: Albert Tan: Law, evidence and technology. Meet Sparks.
svg.desc: Sparks is an animated fictional digital companion, a retro research robot in charcoal and aged bronze with warm amber lights. Current game state: curious. Energy 85, curiosity 84, joy 85. Spark, day 0. What would count as good evidence? Updated 29 Oct 2026 · 10:28 SGT. These are game values, not measurements of Albert Tan.
